summary: An Ontario man lost $260,000 after being lured into a pump-and-dump stock scam promoted through fake online forums and social media ads impersonating a reputable financial platform.
user_mistake: exposed to social media ads and online forums falsely using trusted financial brand logos and promising quick profits
prevention: be skeptical of investment advice on social media, verify sources independently, never trust promises of quick or guaranteed profits, and consult licensed financial advisors
